Class HealthReport

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.HealthReport
public class HealthReport extends Object
The HealthReport is the object returned by an integrity check of one region. The object stores the region id. The object stores whether the region is usable. The object stores a detail string. A caller reads those three values. A null detail is stored as an empty string. A usable region can carry an empty detail. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#HealthReport roux-design.md

      public HealthReport(String regionId, boolean healthy, String detail)
      The constructor stores the region id, the usable flag, and the detail. A null detail is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the checked region.
      healthy - The flag is true when the region is usable.
      detail - The detail is the failure text, or an empty string.
